import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
plt.rcParams['figure.figsize'] = [14, 10]
plt.rcParams['font.size'] = 12

# Load data
df = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Create figure with subplots
fig = plt.figure(constrained_layout=True, figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3)

# Subplot 1: Survival by passenger class and gender
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, :2])
survival_data = df.groupby(['pclass', 'sex', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
survival_data_percent = survival_data.div(survival_data.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

x = np.arange(len(survival_data_percent.index))
width = 0.35

bars1 = ax1.bar(x - width/2, survival_data_percent[1], width, 
                label='Survived', color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black')
bars2 = ax1.bar(x + width/2, survival_data_percent[0], width, 
                label='Did not survive', color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black')

ax1.set_xlabel('Passenger Class & Gender', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Gender', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_xticks(x)
ax1.set_xticklabels([f'Class {pclass}\n{gender.capitalize()}' 
                     for (pclass, gender) in survival_data_percent.index])
ax1.legend()
ax1.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels on bars
for bars in [bars1, bars2]:
    for bar in bars:
        height = bar.get_height()
        if height > 0:
            ax1.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
                    f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Subplot 2: Age distribution by survival status
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 1]['age'].dropna()
not_survived_age = df[df['survived'] == 0]['age'].dropna()

bins = np.arange(0, 85, 5)
ax2.hist([survived_age, not_survived_age], bins=bins, 
         label=['Survived', 'Did not survive'], 
         color=['#2ecc71', '#e74c3c'], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax2.legend()
ax2.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 3: Survival by embarkation port
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
embark_survival = df.groupby(['embark_town', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
embark_survival_percent = embark_survival.div(embark_survival.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

x_embark = np.arange(len(embark_survival_percent))
bars3 = ax3.bar(x_embark - 0.2, embark_survival_percent[1], 0.4, 
                color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black', label='Survived')
bars4 = ax3.bar(x_embark + 0.2, embark_survival_percent[0], 0.4, 
                color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black', label='Did not survive')

ax3.set_xlabel('Embarkation Port', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_title('Survival Rate by Embarkation Port', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax3.set_xticks(x_embark)
ax3.set_xticklabels(embark_survival_percent.index)
ax3.legend()
ax3.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Add value labels
for i, (bar1, bar2) in enumerate(zip(bars3, bars4)):
    for bar in [bar1, bar2]:
        height = bar.get_height()
        if height > 0:
            ax3.text(bar.get_x() + bar.get_width()/2., height + 0.5,
                    f'{height:.1f}%', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=9)

# Subplot 4: Fare distribution by passenger class
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
fare_data = [df[df['pclass'] == i]['fare'].dropna() for i in range(1, 4)]
box = ax4.boxplot(fare_data, patch_artist=True, labels=['First', 'Second', 'Third'])

colors = ['#3498db', '#9b59b6', '#f39c12']
for patch, color in zip(box['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)

for element in ['whiskers', 'caps', 'medians']:
    plt.setp(box[element], color='black')

ax4.set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_ylabel('Fare', fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Fare Distribution by Passenger Class', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 5: Family size vs survival
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['family_size'] = df['sibsp'] + df['parch'] + 1
family_survival = df.groupby(['family_size', 'survived']).size().unstack(fill_value=0)
family_survival_percent = family_survival.div(family_survival.sum(axis=1), axis=0) * 100

x_family = np.arange(len(family_survival_percent))
width_family = 0.35
bars5 = ax5.bar(x_family - width_family/2, family_survival_percent[1], width_family,
                color='#2ecc71', edgecolor='black', label='Survived')
bars6 = ax5.bar(x_family + width_family/2, family_survival_percent[0], width_family,
                color='#e74c3c', edgecolor='black', label='Did not survive')

ax5.set_xlabel('Family Size', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Percentage (%)', fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Survival Rate by Family Size', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_xticks(x_family)
ax5.set_xticklabels(family_survival_percent.index)
ax5.legend()
ax5.grid(True, alpha=0.3)

# Subplot 6: Survival correlation heatmap
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, :])
numeric_cols = ['survived', 'pclass', 'age', 'sibsp', 'parch', 'fare']
correlation_data = df[numeric_cols].corr()

mask = np.triu(np.ones_like(correlation_data, dtype=bool))
cmap = sns.diverging_palette(220, 20, as_cmap=True)
sns.heatmap(correlation_data, mask=mask, cmap=cmap, vmax=1, vmin=-1, center=0,
            square=True, linewidths=1, cbar_kws={"shrink": 0.8}, annot=True,
            fmt=".2f", ax=ax6)
ax6.set_title('Correlation Heatmap of Numerical Features', fontsize=14, fontweight='bold')

# Add overall title
fig.suptitle('Titanic Passenger Survival Analysis', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold', y=1.02)

# Save figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150, facecolor='white')
